title: Health
description: S-5. Served at /health, which is deliberately unversioned: it is the discovery endpoint, and a versioned one has a bootstrap problem — you would need to know the version to ask which versions exist.

status.description: Process liveness, which is a different question from whether the data is any good. A stuck sensor is ok here and wrong in /v1/reading, and ops must be able to see both.

versions.description: V-2. API versions this sensor speaks. The collector negotiates against it (V-3).

clock.description: N-2. Time agreement is a runtime observable, not an assumption.

firmware.description: G-6. Reports the running version, which slot is active, and how the last attempt ended — including a revert, which is a normal outcome and not an error.

mode.description: F-1. Visible to ops and admin only; the collector never sees this endpoint's control fields (A-2).
